metadata.provider: mixed cached history: Sina houfuquan-derived, Tencent hfq, Eastmoney fqt=2
metadata.liquidity_amount: Tencent uses raw close * volume_in_hands * 100 proxy; Eastmoney uses reported amount
metadata.signal_clock: all rules use the signal close and prior completed bars only
metadata.entry_clock: next tradable bar open; one-price estimated up-limit entries skipped
metadata.horizon_convention: H means signal+H close, entered signal+1 open; exactly H post-signal stock trading bars
metadata.liquidity_filter: prior-exclusive 20-bar median amount >= RMB 30m; RMB 50m is predeclared sensitivity
metadata.sell_direction_semantics: down-frequency/avoidance observation, not a short-sale strategy; raw underlying return is used

selection_integrity.multiple_testing: Holm family-wise 5% over each signal's predeclared primary horizon
selection_integrity.time_splits: era/year summaries require exit date inside the period (purged boundary)

source_validation.note: Back- and front-adjusted price levels differ; validation compares scale-free daily returns and candle close location.

event_ledger.format: gzip JSON Lines; one row per signal/horizon outcome

signal_definitions.label: 低位破低反包
signal_definitions.rule: DD60<=-15%; prior-10d<=-10%; Below20>=10; lower low + higher high; close above prior high; bullish; CLV>=.75; TR/ATR20>=1.2; VR20>=1.2

signal_definitions.label: 金针探底观察
signal_definitions.rule: DD60<=-20%; Below20>=10; low breaks LL20 and close reclaims it; lower shadow>=.50; CLV>=.65; body<=.35; TR/ATR20>=.8

signal_definitions.label: 金针探底确认
signal_definitions.rule: Within 1-3 bars after hammer: first close above anchor high and MA5, CLV>=.55; invalidated by low below anchor low minus .25 anchor ATR

signal_definitions.label: 深跌巨量强收
signal_definitions.rule: DD60<=-25%; Below20>=10; close<=MA20; VR20>=2.5; bullish; CLV>=.70

signal_definitions.label: 巨量后缩量不破转强
signal_definitions.rule: 2-7 bars after capitulation: lows hold within 2%; at least one VR<=.70; then bullish close above prior high/anchor midpoint with CLV>=.65 and 1<=VR<=3.5

signal_definitions.label: 三日极度缩量企稳
signal_definitions.rule: DD60<=-15%; Below20>=10; median last-3 volume/VMA60<=.45; three-day low holds prior floor within 2%; three-day close change within 3%

signal_definitions.label: 极缩量后脱离平台
signal_definitions.rule: Within 1-3 bars: first close above anchor three-day high and MA5; bullish; CLV>=.65; 1<=VR<=3.5; invalid if platform low breaks by 2%

signal_definitions.label: 双底量能背离观察
signal_definitions.rule: Compare current low with the unique earliest trough 40-10 bars ago; lows within 3%; current normalized volume <=70% of first trough; lower shadow>=.25

signal_definitions.label: 双底放量破颈线
signal_definitions.rule: Within 1-5 bars: first close above frozen neckline; CLV>=.65; VR>=1.2; invalid if current trough breaks by 3%

signal_definitions.label: 高位巨量长上影
signal_definitions.rule: Prior Ret20>=15%; MA5>MA10 and MA10 rising; prior close>MA5; new HH20; VR20>=2.5; upper shadow>=.55; CLV<=.35; TR/ATR20>=1

signal_definitions.label: 巨量长上影跌破确认
signal_definitions.rule: Within 1-3 bars after upper rejection: first close below anchor low

signal_definitions.label: 放量假突破观察
signal_definitions.rule: Prior Ret20>=10%; MA5>MA10; high>=1.005*HH20 but close<=HH20; VR>=1.5; CLV<=.45; upper shadow>=.25; excludes strict huge-upper family

signal_definitions.label: 假突破跌破确认
signal_definitions.rule: Within 1-2 bars after failed breakout: first close below anchor low

signal_definitions.label: 双顶量能背离观察
signal_definitions.rule: Compare current high with unique earliest peak 40-10 bars ago; highs within -2%/+5%; current normalized volume <=70% of first peak; upper shadow>=.20; CLV<=.55

signal_definitions.label: 双顶放量破颈线
signal_definitions.rule: Within 1-5 bars: first close below frozen neckline; CLV<=.35; VR>=1.2; invalid if current peak is exceeded by 5%

limitations: This is a retrospective event study. Existing data through 2026-08-20 have already informed adjacent research; it is not a pristine future holdout.
The expanded-symbol cohort is a cross-sectional holdout relative to the earlier 249-symbol studies, but definitions still reflect general market knowledge.
The history endpoints do not provide point-in-time ST names, raw adjustment factors, delisting returns, or order-book fill data.
Shanghai/Shenzhen historical securities come from BaoStock stock basic; Beijing coverage is the current Hanai master, so delisted historical BSE names may be absent.
Back-adjusted prices preserve local scale-free shapes but use adjustment information known later; raw-price limit checks are approximated from adjusted ratios.
One-price up-limit checks model board/date rules but cannot reconstruct historical ST 5% limits, temporary IPO exemptions, or intraday queue availability.
Same-day controls match board, prior drawdown/run-up and liquidity tier; observational matching reduces confounding but does not establish causality.
Signals are de-duplicated per symbol and signal stage; overlapping market-wide events remain correlated and are handled approximately with stock/month two-way clustering.
Historical conditional frequency, even when statistically stable, cannot guarantee future profits and is sensitive to regime, costs and implementation.
